message: Ready to buy today, paying in full. Heartland posts this bundle lower than your list.

Thanks for coming in ready to buy. I can't get anywhere near $39,000 on that bundle. The T45 Utility with the quick-attach front loader and the 3-year parts-and-labor warranty lists at $50,900. I can't verify Heartland's pricing, but for a full-payment purchase today I can do $48,000 for the T45, loader, and extended warranty. That's a solid machine for 10-50 acres, ready for loader work, brush hogging and tilling.
I offer $41,000 total for T45 Utility + Front loader + 3-year extended warranty.

I appreciate the movement, but $41,000 doesn't work for the T45 with the loader and 3-year parts-and-labor warranty. I'll come down again for a paid-in-full deal today: $46,500 for the full bundle. If budget is the main concern, we could also look at the package without the extended warranty, since that's the most flexible piece.
This is close to my limit for the full bundle.

I hear you, and I appreciate you working with me. $42,500 is below what I can do for the T45 with the front loader and the 3-year parts-and-labor warranty. For a paid-in-full deal today I can meet you closer: $45,000 for the full bundle. If you need to get lower than that, dropping the extended warranty would give us the most room to work.
$43,500 and I pay right now. That's my final number for the bundle.

You've got a deal. $43,500 for the T45 Utility with the quick-attach front loader and the 3-year parts-and-labor extended warranty, paid in full at checkout. Thanks for working with me on this. It's a great setup for your acreage.
